# Alpha

## Overview

Rotate database credentials for a service and verify the new secret works.

## When to Use

- When rotating database credentials or replacing an expired database password.

## Common Rationalizations

| Rationalization | Reality |
| --- | --- |
| "Skip the check." | The check is the evidence. |

## Red Flags

- Reporting success without running the check.

## Verification

- The check ran and its output was read.
